description: This file defines interfaces for blocking closure mechanisms used in IPC communication within the Rialto project. It includes factory methods for creating blocking closures that either poll or use semaphores, and a class representing a blocking closure with a wait method.

classes.name: IBlockingClosureFactory
classes.description: Factory interface for creating different types of IBlockingClosure objects, either polling or semaphore-based.

classes.name: IBlockingClosure
classes.description: Interface representing a blocking closure with a wait method to synchronize IPC responses.

methods.name: createFactory
methods.description: Creates and returns a shared pointer to an IBlockingClosureFactory instance.

methods.name: createBlockingClosurePoll
methods.description: Creates a polling IBlockingClosure object that pumps the event loop during wait.

methods.name: createBlockingClosureSemaphore
methods.description: Creates a semaphore-based IBlockingClosure object that does not pump the event loop during wait.

methods.name: wait
methods.description: Blocks execution until the response is received.
